args.body:
Summary of https://blog.corvid.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/cold-chain/companion):

- In 2026, temperature excursions fell 30% at carriers that shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, rather than reduced spoilage.
- The companion piece reports that pilots cut claims by a quarter (25%).
args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary
